title: retire bin/arc-tui-loop.sh shim
body_md: bin/arc-tui-loop.sh is a 30s polling bash wrapper around arc-tui heartbeat/list. Once the Ink-based arc-tui lands (queued: arc-tui-ink-based-interactive-tui), this shim is redundant. Pre-emptively schedule its retirement: mark as deprecated in a comment + add ADR-style note in commit message; full deletion is a follow-up gated on Ink rewrite landing.
